description:
Rename "source" to "agent run" in Go code and the dashboard, to match docs/00-glossary.md. No design talk needed.

Glossary: an agent is a named role in a pipeline; an agent run is one Claude Code execution of it inside a run. Today that is a "source": the source input of integrations/claude-code and integrations/claude-code-otlp, Run.Sources and SourceUsage (internal/core/model.go, telemetry.go), Report.Source, run_tokens.source.

Change Go names and dashboard wording. The run page already says "Claude Code steps" and "Source ..." in event details (internal/web/templates.html); use "agent run".

Keep for backwards compatibility: the action input name source, JSON keys (sources, source), the run_tokens.source column, the agbredo.source OTLP label. Deployed workflows and stored rows depend on these.

Check: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./..., plus the Python tests in CLAUDE.md if the integrations change.
title: Rename source to agent run in code and dashboard
